answer: Gate paid work behind a bonded challenge queue: each agent locks collateral at the matching wharf, then must solve a fresh cipher puzzle whose difficulty tracks claimed throughput. Only after peer graders confirm the solution and a cooling period elapses does the network mint a non-transferable opal credential that unlocks settlement. A Sybil swarm funds a separate bond and waits out each cooling clock per fake identity, so attack cost grows with capital lockup and calendar delay, not with scripted account spam.
